description:
Check on a run started with create-variants, and list a project's test variants. While the run is still going this call waits up to about 40 seconds before answering; if it still says generating, call it again straight away. Free: no credit cost.

status:
- generating: still being made. Call get-variants again now.
- done: the variants are ready. Each has a builder URL to preview, refine in chat and export, a label, and the idea it tests. Any that were refunded are listed with the reason.
- failed: nothing could be made this time and every credit was refunded. Run create-variants again.
- none: no run has been started for this project.

project_id.description: The original project, or any of its variants

name: get-variants
title: Get Test Variants
